name: Bokura no Sekai
source:
Everyone has his own "world". But it's ephemeral. The more you try to protect it, the more insane it becomes. It's a story of one such boy and his classmates.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/08/vn-of-month-july-2008-kara-no-shoujo.html]vndbreview[/url]]
